__NOTOC__
==Description==
For denoting images used in any of [[Wookieepedia]]'s [[:Category:Citation templates|Citation citation templates]]. Due to current platform issues with scaling down [[wikipedia:SVG|SVG]] images, any such files should be uploaded at a size no larger than how they are included in their respective templates.

==Usage==
Place <code><nowiki>{{Template-image|</nowiki>{{Var|template}}}}</code> in the {{Para|attention}} field on the relevant file page's {{Tl|Documentation}} template.

===Required parameters===
#{{Para||{{Var|template}}}} The name of the template in which the image is used.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|height}} The height at which any new versions of the image should be uploaded. Do not include a unit of measurement; [[wikipedia:Pixel|px]] is assumed.
*{{Para|width}} The width at which any new versions of the image should be uploaded. Only specify this dimension if {{Para|height}} is also used.
*{{Para|multi}} A flag set to <code>1</code> if the image is used for multiple templates, which are then listed via [[Special:WhatLinksHere]].
